Final Camera Raw Filter as read from the open document after the user saved the TIFF (the TIFF file itself was not re-opened from disk). raw_so_manual.Calibration: Blue primary Hue -6, Saturation +9 (user, set in the filter dialog; stored $BHue -6, $BSat 9; $RHue $RSat $GHue $GSat $BlkB = 0)

ai_masks_user: Sky (Landscape 50006) - sky/fog, clean edge against the rock
hero (object mask Object 1 + paint dabs) - the red spire, full silhouette incl. the base
Mountain (Select Subject, MaskSubType 1) - ALL rock of the frame incl. the shaded holes; sky untouched (probe +0.25: sky 0.0, rock +17...+19 L*)
background (Object 1 + paint - Aggregate Brush) - misses two shaded zones (behind the spire, under the arch): NOT used
Foreground (Object 1 + paint) - only a thin bottom-left strip after the crop: NOT used
tree (object mask + paint, user, added after the plan) - the small pine at the bottom

crop._note: final window in FULL-FRAME coordinates; commit 1 was y 0-4642, commit 2 (final) moved the window down. The second crop was sent in the first canvas' coordinates (top 819 bottom 5461) and revealed the hidden pixels (delete:false).
